name: Navigate forward in Edge mobile
summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The person asked a quick technical question about Microsoft Edge on mobile, specifically how to navigate forward after accidentally going back. Claude explained that swiping from the right edge of the screen toward the center triggers the forward navigation gesture in Edge mobile.
